The pipeline was built so that downstream tasks pause and retry if shop data fails to arrive, which reduces the chance of partial loads. On a product analytics project, a survival-analysis model isolated a day-3 churn spike and measured the effect of onboarding variations.

Proposed first step: a one-week audit of your site-level sources, checking definitions and join keys, followed by a short dashboard of the three metrics your strategy depends on, with a plain-language summary for non-technical stakeholders.
